title: Mental Health Management for Entrepreneurs: Navigating Stressors and Evaluating AI-Driven Interventions

detail.title: Mental Health Management for Entrepreneurs: Navigating Stressors and Evaluating AI-Driven Interventions
detail.abstract: Entrepreneurship serves as a critical engine for economic growth; however, founders frequently encounter disproportionate mental health challenges, characterized by elevated levels of anxiety, burnout, and social isolation. Despite the gravity of these issues, prevailing stigmatization and the pervasive ”hustle culture” often deter entrepreneurs from seeking necessary professional intervention. This study investigates the structural and psychological stressors intrinsic to entrepreneurship and evaluates the efficacy of contemporary digital mental health interventions. To address the paucity of research regarding AI-driven support in high-stress occupational contexts, a study was conducted utilizing undergraduate students as entrepreneurial proxies to assess ”Wysa,” an AI-based mental health chatbot. Participants (n = 18 initial, n = 7 final) engaged in a four-week intervention comprising simulated entrepreneurial tasks, with pre- and post-assessments measured via the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS-10). Contrary to the initial hypothesis, quantitative analysis demonstrated a slight exacerbation in perceived stress levels post-intervention (Mean score increase from 17.33 to 21.14). Qualitative feedback indicated that while the AI offered a valuable non-judgmental environment, its generic algorithmic responses were insufficient in addressing specific, context-dependent stressors. Consequently, this research underscores the limitations of generalized digital tools and highlights the critical imperative for developing context-aware, adaptive mental health solutions specifically tailored to the dynamic and high-pressure exigencies of entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨企业家面临的心理健康挑战，通过对18名（最终7名）大学生进行为期四周的Wysa AI心理健康聊天机器人干预实验（以模拟创业任务为情境），发现AI聊天机器人未能降低压力水平（PSS-10得分从17.33升至21.14），尽管提供了非评判性环境，但通用算法回应无法应对特定情境压力源，凸显了开发针对创业情境的上下文感知适应性心理健康解决方案的必要性。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的数字心理健康干预（特别是Wysa聊天机器人）在高压创业情境下是否能有效缓解创业者的感知压力？
AI.motivation: 创业者面临不成比例的心理健康挑战（焦虑、倦怠、社会隔离），但由于污名化和"拼搏文化"的盛行，创业者往往不愿寻求专业干预。同时，关于AI驱动在高压力职业情境中支持作用的研究严重缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业压力理论（结构性压力源与心理压力源）、数字心理健康干预理论、感知压力量表（PSS-10）评估框架
AI.method: 实验研究：以大学生为创业代理被试，进行为期四周的干预实验，被试参与模拟创业任务并使用Wysa AI心理健康聊天机器人；通过PSS-10量表进行前后测对比，结合定性与定量分析方法（初始18人，最终7人完成）。
AI.findings: 与最初假设相反，干预后感知压力水平略有恶化（均值从17.33升至21.14）；定性反馈显示AI提供了有价值的非评判性环境，但其通用算法回应不足以应对具体、情境依赖的压力源。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了通用型数字心理健康工具在特定高压力职业情境（创业）中的局限性；为AI心理健康干预的情境适配性研究提供了实证证据；挑战了"数字心理健康工具普遍有效"的前提假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者心理健康支持方案的设计提供指导——强调需要开发上下文感知、自适应的心理健康解决方案；对数字心理健康产品开发者提出针对性改进建议（情境化回应能力）；为创业生态系统中的心理健康关怀实践提供参考。

title: Pathogen-specific temporal patterns of bacterial gastrointestinal infection claims in South Korea: implications for surveillance interpretation
affiliations: Kongju National University, Chungbuk National University and Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service - Department of Research

detail.title: Pathogen-specific temporal patterns of bacterial gastrointestinal infection claims in South Korea: implications for surveillance interpretation
detail.abstract: BackgroundBacterial gastrointestinal infections remain an important public health concern, but their claims-based temporal patterns may differ substantially across pathogens. We examined whether pathogen-specific temporal structure in administrative claims data could inform surveillance interpretation for bacterial gastrointestinal infections in South Korea.MethodsThis retrospective ecological time-series study used nationwide South Korean health insurance claims data from 2014 to 2023 to construct monthly region-level claims-based occurrence series for 11 bacterial gastrointestinal pathogens across 17 administrative regions. Temporal structure was summarized by claims-based occurrence level, variability, and seasonal concentration. Forecast stability and surveillance interpretation were assessed using SARIMAX, CatBoost, and a seasonal naive baseline, with predictor sets including prior claims-based occurrence and climate variables. Robustness was evaluated using alternative lag specifications and temporal train-test splits. Results Claims-based temporal structure varied markedly across pathogens. Salmonella spp. and Campylobacter spp. showed the highest mean monthly claims-based occurrence and relatively lower variability, whereas Bacillus cereus, enteroinvasive Escherichia coli (EIEC), and Listeria monocytogenes showed mean monthly occurrence below 1 and greater instability. Pathogens with higher occurrence and clearer seasonal concentration generally showed more interpretable forecast performance, whereas sparse pathogens showed low absolute errors but unstable percentage-based error measures. Recent claims-based occurrence was the most consistently informative predictor, whereas climate variables contributed selectively across pathogens.ConclusionsPathogen-specific claims-based temporal structure was associated with differences in forecast stability and surveillance interpretation. Routine forecasting appeared more interpretable for pathogens with higher occurrence and clearer seasonal concentration, whereas sparse and unstable patterns were more difficult to interpret using routine point forecasting alone and may warrant supplementary interpretive approaches. These findings suggest that administrative surveillance signals for bacterial gastrointestinal pathogens may benefit from interpretation that is more attentive to pathogen-specific temporal structure.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用韩国2014-2023年全国健康保险理赔数据，对11种细菌性胃肠道病原体在17个行政区域的月度理赔发生序列进行时间结构分析，发现不同病原体的时间结构差异显著，高发生率和强季节集中度的病原体预测更可解释，而稀疏病原体则需补充解释方法。
AI.research_question: 细菌性胃肠道感染的行政理赔数据中，不同病原体的时间结构特征如何影响基于理赔数据的监测预报稳定性和监测解读？
AI.motivation: 细菌性胃肠道感染仍是重要的公共卫生问题，但不同病原体在理赔数据中的时间模式可能差异显著，现有研究对这些差异及其对监测解读的影响关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列分析理论，涵盖理赔发生水平、变异性和季节性集中度三个维度的时间结构框架，以及监测预报可解释性理论。
AI.method: 回顾性生态时间序列研究；使用2014-2023年韩国全国健康保险理赔数据，构建11种细菌性胃肠道病原体在17个行政区的月度理赔发生序列；采用SARIMAX、CatBoost和季节朴素基线模型评估预报稳定性；使用替代滞后设定和时间分割进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 不同病原体的理赔时间结构差异显著：沙门氏菌和弯曲杆菌发生率高且变异性低；蜡样芽孢杆菌、EIEC和单核细胞增生李斯特菌月均发生低于1且不稳定。高发生率和强季节集中度的病原体预报更可解释，稀疏病原体绝对误差低但百分比误差不稳定。近期理赔发生是最一致的预测变量，气候变量仅对特定病原体有贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了按病原体特定时间结构（发生率、变异性、季节集中度）来评估行政监测预报可解释性的理论框架，为理赔数据监测解读提供了病原体特异性的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国细菌性胃肠道感染的行政保险理赔监测提供实践指导，建议对高发生率和强季节性的病原体使用常规预报，而对稀疏不稳定病原体采用补充性解释方法，以提高监测信号解读的准确性。

title: Apocynin Species for Sustainable Utilization of Saline Lands: Biological Traits, Salt Tolerance, and Economic Potential

detail.title: Apocynin Species for Sustainable Utilization of Saline Lands: Biological Traits, Salt Tolerance, and Economic Potential
detail.abstract: Background information Increasing soil salinization, water shortages, and land degradation are serious problems for agricultural productivity and sustainable land use, especially in arid and semi-arid regions. Apocynin L. spp., especially Apocynin Veneto L. Subsp. and Apocynin pactum Schlenk (A. pactum), are naturally occurring in marginal, saline, and drought-prone habitats. Soils impacted by ecological degradation can be used productively and are suitable for ecological restoration. At the same time, they are also promising crops for bio saline agriculture due to their ability to produce biomass and fiber under challenging conditions.Objective: This review aims to provide insight into the ecological, physiological, economic, and molecular characteristics of Apocynin spp., which make them adaptable to dry and saline conditions. It emphasizes mechanisms of salt tolerance and the potential of A. Veneto and A. pactum for sustainable agricultural production, ecological reclamation, and industrial development.Methods: Evidence gathered from ecological, physiological, transcriptomic, metabolomic and gene-specific studies of Apocynin was used in a multidisciplinary synthesis of previously conducted research. The study of responses to salt, drought, and alkaline stress, and stress response-related genes, including ApHKT1, was given special consideration. The ecological importance, fiber traits, medicinal values, and industrial/agricultural uses of Apocynin species were also considered.Results: The study revealed high salinity tolerance, drought stress, and alkaline stress among Apocynin spp., which can be established and maintained on degraded and saline soils with limited conventional crop productivity. Therefore, A. Veneto and A. pactum are good species for ecological restoration and bio saline agriculture. They can be cultivated to help manage marginal areas sustainably, stabilize soil, and conserve water. Apart from their ecological value, Apocynin species are also economically valuable because their best fibers are used in the production of quality textiles and their leaves are rich in bioactive compounds, which are used in herbal teas and traditional medicine. However, molecular investigations also indicate that the stress tolerance of these species is connected to the coordinated control of ion homeostasis, osmotic adjustment and antioxidant defense. Transcriptional and metabolomic studies, as well as molecular studies of individual genes like ApHKT1, have revealed mechanisms that maintain cellular ion homeostasis and reduce oxidative and osmotic stress in plants.Conclusions. Apocynin species, especially A. Veneto and A. pactum, are multifunctional tools to address the “stovepipe” problem of interlinked issues of salinization, water scarcity, land degradation, and rural economic development. The multifaceted benefits for ecological resilience, fiber yield, and therapeutic applications provide strong motivation for exploring strategies for economic crop production in tandem with environmental rehabilitation.Significance: The results indicate that under growing environmental stress, Apocynin can be a significant crop for sustainable agriculture. Future studies could focus on population genomic analysis, marker-assisted selection, and systematic germplasm collection and characterization to enhance biomass yield, salt tolerance, and fiber quality. AI.tldr: 本文综述了罗布麻属植物（特别是罗布麻和大叶白麻）在盐碱、干旱等逆境条件下的生态适应性、耐盐机制及其在生态修复和生物盐碱农业中的多用途潜力。研究表明这些物种通过离子稳态、渗透调节和抗氧化防御的协同调控来应对胁迫，兼具生态修复、纤维生产和药用价值，是应对盐碱化、水资源短缺和土地退化综合问题的重要多功能作物。
AI.research_question: 罗布麻属植物（尤其是罗布麻和大叶白麻）在干旱和盐碱条件下具备哪些生态、生理、经济和分子特性，使其能够适应恶劣环境，并可用于可持续农业、生态恢复和工业发展？
AI.motivation: 土壤盐碱化、水资源短缺和土地退化是干旱半干旱地区农业生产和可持续土地利用面临的严重问题。罗布麻属植物天然生长于边际性、盐碱和干旱胁迫生境中，有望成为生物盐碱农业和生态修复的候选作物，但其综合特性尚未得到系统性梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 耐盐性机制理论（离子稳态调控、渗透调节、抗氧化防御系统），生态修复理论，生物盐碱农业理论
AI.method: 多学科综述方法：整合生态学、生理学、转录组学、代谢组学和基因特异性研究证据，特别关注盐、干旱和碱胁迫响应以及ApHKT1等胁迫响应基因的研究。
AI.findings: 1）罗布麻属植物对盐胁迫、干旱胁迫和碱胁迫具有高度耐受性，可在常规作物难以生产的退化和盐碱土壤上建立和维持；2）其胁迫耐受性与离子稳态、渗透调节和抗氧化防御的协同调控有关；3）转录组和代谢组研究以及ApHKT1等基因的分子研究揭示了维持细胞离子稳态、减少氧化和渗透胁迫的机制；4）罗布麻属植物具有生态价值（水土保持、土壤稳定）、经济价值（高品质纤维用于纺织品、叶片富含生物活性化合物用于草药茶和传统医学）。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了罗布麻属植物在多学科层面的耐逆机制证据，将生态学、生理学和分子层面的研究统一纳入综合分析框架，揭示了离子稳态、渗透调节和抗氧化防御协同调控的耐盐机制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出罗布麻属植物（罗布麻和大叶白麻）可作为应对盐碱化、水资源短缺、土地退化和农村经济发展的多功能工具；为生物盐碱农业和生态修复提供候选作物物种；建议未来开展群体基因组分析、标记辅助选择和种质资源系统收集与鉴定以提升生物量和纤维品质。

title: ST-nnUNet: A High-Precision Segmentation Method for the Maxillary First Molar Pulp Cavity Based on a Self-Constructed Dataset
affiliations: Jianghan University, Jianghan University, Jianghan University, Jianghan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Jianghan University, Jianghan University, Jianghan University, Jianghan University, Jianghan University, Jianghan University and Jianghan University

detail.title: ST-nnUNet: A High-Precision Segmentation Method for the Maxillary First Molar Pulp Cavity Based on a Self-Constructed Dataset
detail.abstract: Background and Objective: High-precision segmentation of the dental pulp cavity in Cone Beam Computed Tomography images is crucial for root canal therapy. However, extremely low contrast, minute complex branches, and the scarcity of specialized endodontic clinical datasets severely limit the development of existing methods. The objective of this study is to develop a highly robust and automated segmentation framework that effectively overcomes these limitations.Methods: This study proposes a hybrid deep learning segmentation network, ST-nnUNet, validated on a self-constructed dataset of 400 maxillary left first molar pulp cavities established through an iterative human-in-the-loop mechanism. The architecture seamlessly integrates the localized feature extraction of nnU-Net with the long-range spatial topology modeling capability of Swin Transformer. Additionally, a geometric boundary-aware loss function is innovatively introduced to strengthen spatial boundary constraints on minute root canals.Results: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves a Dice coefficient of 88.53% and a 95% Hausdorff Distance of 1.33 millimeters, effectively overcoming the topological disconnection problem in minute variant root canals. Furthermore, the applied human-in-the-loop strategy reduces clinical data annotation time by nearly 90%.Conclusions: This study achieves an exceptional balance between inference efficiency and segmentation accuracy. By preserving fine topological continuity and drastically reducing annotation workloads, the proposed method provides an efficient and highly robust solution for precise clinical three-dimensional reconstruction and intelligent endodontic diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ST-nnUNet混合深度学习分割网络，用于CBCT图像中牙髓腔的高精度分割。通过融合nnU-Net的局部特征提取与Swin Transformer的长距离空间拓扑建模，并引入几何边界感知损失函数，在400例上颌第一磨牙牙髓腔数据集上实现88.53%的Dice系数和1.33毫米的95%豪斯多夫距离。人机协同标注策略将临床数据标注时间减少近90%。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种高度鲁棒且自动化的分割框架，以克服CBCT图像中牙髓腔分割面临的低对比度、微小复杂分支和临床数据集稀缺等限制？
AI.motivation: 根管治疗对CBCT图像中牙髓腔的高精度分割至关重要，但极低对比度、微小复杂分支以及专业牙髓病临床数据集的稀缺严重制约了现有方法的发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习分割理论，包括nnU-Net局部特征提取、Swin Transformer长距离空间拓扑建模，以及几何边界感知损失函数理论。
AI.method: 提出ST-nnUNet混合分割网络，融合nnU-Net与Swin Transformer架构；引入几何边界感知损失函数强化微小根管的空间边界约束；采用迭代人机协同机制构建400例上颌第一磨牙牙髓腔数据集。
AI.findings: 模型实现88.53%的Dice系数和1.33毫米的95%豪斯多夫距离；有效克服微小变异根管的拓扑不连续问题；人机协同策略将临床数据标注时间减少近90%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将局部特征提取与长距离空间拓扑建模相结合的混合分割架构，创新性地引入几何边界感知损失函数以加强微小根管的空间边界约束，为解决低对比度微小结构分割提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了高效且高鲁棒性的临床三维重建与智能牙髓病诊断解决方案；通过人机协同标注大幅降低临床数据标注成本；在推理效率与分割精度之间实现了卓越平衡。
